mapper.insert: INSERT INTO xsy_order_operation_log (order_id, customer_id, operation_type, operator, reason, before_data, after_data, created_by) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{customerId}, #{operationType}, #{operator}, #{reason}, #{beforeData,typeHandler=com.xsy.scm.order.support.OrderJsonbTypeHandler}, #{afterData,typeHandler=com.xsy.scm.order.support.OrderJsonbTypeHandler}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM xsy_order_operation_log WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY created_at, id
